mustBeforeDemo.title: Every live load briefly says 'No activity yet'
mustBeforeDemo.why:
setSnapshot runs before the history is fetched (use-live-dashboard.ts:230, before the await at :236; confirmed at HEAD). So for about 0.5 s on every live load the page says:
- the feed: 'No activity yet…'
- the footer: '0 events · 0 settlements'
- the chart: 'not in the history loaded here'
- the strip shows a 'Load older' button that does nothing
- the rule card: 'No investments yet'
The stats also jump from 2 tiles to 7. A demo video of the owner's own pension will capture exactly this, and it looks like lost history.
mustBeforeDemo.fix:
1. On the first read (until===null), keep the snapshot in a local variable. Set snapshot, entries and activityMeta together once the head page answers or fails. React batches them into one render, and the skeleton stays up about 0.5 s longer.
2. Do NOT hold the page for the link-settlement backfill: it can take up to BACKFILL_PAGES=2 × wallets sequential round trips (live-backfill.ts:61-63). Instead, force settledOutsideHistory=false while it runs (live-model.ts:676).
3. Add `available: activityMeta?.nextBefore != null` to LiveOlder, and render Load older only when available (savings-strip.tsx:80-95, LiveActivityPage.tsx:169-175).
4. Add a hook test.

keepAsIs: Honest states: a Live page never falls back to sample numbers. A failed read is never offered as 'create a vault'. Unknown values show '—', never zero (dashboard-shell.tsx:452-460, LiveNextStep.tsx:12-15, account-chip.tsx:44-55, pension-panel.tsx:97-105).

Costs and consequences are stated before every signature: vault rent, link rent, the order of Phantom prompts, the nonce notice, 'two signatures' (LiveNextStep.tsx:73, VaultCard.tsx:203-204, savings-rule-panel.tsx:237-254). Simplify the wording; do not remove them.

Write safety: one screen-wide lock; 'Not confirmed yet' offers only Check again; an expired blockhash offers Build again; the TxProgress ladder ends with a Solscan link. WithdrawCard's in-flight pattern is the model the rule card should copy.

Careful polling: hidden tabs do not poll, retry-after is honoured, late answers are dropped, a new pension key resets everything, and feed row ids stay stable across polls (use-live-dashboard.ts, live-mock.ts:261-274).

The sample dashboard reads as one system on desktop: the 5-tone feed, token marks, tabular mono numbers and UTC times, with CLS 0 on /?mode=mock. Live fits one screen from 1440x780, and the sample from 1920x1080.
Brand hygiene holds: no 'SIP' or 'Nuvem' in visible text, aria labels or alt text on any reachable page, and the SaverFi mark is the favicon.

The landing is strong: it works before JS loads, 'See the app' is a real link, scroll-to-enter works on phone and desktop, and the sample is always labelled. A stalled Privy gets a reason plus 'View sample data' (LiveStates.tsx:60-78).
The no-vault 4-step checklist ticked from chain state is the right pattern: extend it to later stages, do not replace it.
/leaderboard stays Privy-free for strangers (230 KB of JS vs 1.2 MB). Keep that separation; do not move it under (dashboard) before Privy is lazy.

Accessibility baseline: text passes WCAG AA in both themes (315 runs measured), there is no page-level horizontal scroll from 375 to 2560 px wide (only the header overflows, at 360 px and below), every stop has a focus indicator, the feed uses a roving tabindex, and reduced motion is honoured.
Tab navigation is client-side: the RSC request leaves at 75-106 ms and there are no full reloads. The tab loader was the owner's 09-23 choice; tune its timing at most.
The phone activity sheet (sticky day headers, close button first in focus order) and the leaderboard's phone layout with a sub-line under each pension.
